title: Re-audit transformations of the SPP1+TAM cross-scale design
plain_language_question: Which scientifically coherent uses of the anchor can produce a beginner-executable manuscript, and what is retained, repaired, replaced, extended, or dropped in each?
biological_unit: Not applicable at the umbrella gate
decisive_evidence: A portfolio with explicit multi-axis change maps, independent assessments, and human-readable trade-offs
falsifier: Fewer than two scientifically coherent and feasible manuscript candidates survive the corrected G0 gates
learning_objective: Learn to compare biological, design, evidence, method, and code reuse without making change count or generic validation the decision rule
target_contribution: A reviewed candidate portfolio rather than an automatically selected audit paper
claim_ceiling: No manuscript claim is authorized by this umbrella direction

title: Cross-cohort transportability and context boundaries of published myeloid states in CRC and CRLM
plain_language_question: Which published CRC or CRLM myeloid programs reproduce across independent patients and spatial datasets?
biological_unit: Patient or independent sample within cohort; independent study for synthesis
decisive_evidence: A cohort-level forest plot with prespecified state mapping and orthogonal spatial localization
falsifier: The state panel cannot be frozen, fewer than three independent cohorts share the main comparison, or patient-level effects do not support a coherent question
learning_objective: Learn metadata lineage, state mapping, replicate-aware inference, evidence synthesis, and spatial validation
target_contribution: A reproducibility and evidence-strength map of published myeloid programs
claim_ceiling: Associational reproducibility, heterogeneity, and spatial localization only

title: External validation of malignancy-linked versus liver-niche-linked immune programs in CRC metastasis
plain_language_question: Which immune programs follow malignant tissue identity and which follow the liver environment across independent CRC metastasis cohorts?
biological_unit: Patient, matched tissue, or independent sample within immune lineage
decisive_evidence: Independent mapping of prespecified malignancy-linked and liver-niche-linked programs across matched tissues and cohorts
falsifier: Study and tissue effects cannot be separated or no independent cohort reproduces the required tissue contrasts
learning_objective: Learn cross-lineage mapping, matched-tissue design, domain shift, and patient-level validation
target_contribution: An externally validated ecological classification of tumor- and organ-associated immune programs
claim_ceiling: Associational ecological alignment only; no lineage origin or causal niche claim

title: Macrophage-program remodeling during neoadjuvant PD-1 therapy in dMMR CRC
plain_language_question: How do prespecified macrophage programs change within patients during neoadjuvant PD-1 treatment, and are changes distinguishable from arm and sampling effects?
biological_unit: Patient with paired or explicitly unpaired treatment samples
decisive_evidence: A patient-aware treatment-change estimate with an independent or orthogonal validation source
falsifier: Treatment arm, pairing, and response cannot be separated or no non-overlapping validation source exists
learning_objective: Learn paired design, response-label auditing, treatment interaction limits, and validation
target_contribution: A modest treatment-context macrophage-remodeling result if dependencies are confirmed
claim_ceiling: Exploratory treatment association only; no efficacy, predictive biomarker, or causal claim

title: Approximate reconstruction of the anchor computational figures
plain_language_question: Which public-data figures can be independently reconstructed, and which discrepancies remain because inputs, code, imaging, or interventions are unavailable?
biological_unit: The anchor's documented patient, sample, or spatial unit for each reconstructed figure
decisive_evidence: A figure-by-figure reconstruction and discrepancy ledger linked to reproducible inputs and runs
falsifier: Public inputs cannot reproduce even the stated qualitative contrasts or provenance remains unresolved
learning_objective: Learn provenance, independent reconstruction, discrepancy reporting, and cross-scale analysis mechanics
target_contribution: A training foundation and reusable adapters, not a stand-alone manuscript
claim_ceiling: Descriptive similarity and documented discrepancies only
